name: spacefast
description: Connect Spacefast to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Spacefast MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Spacefast to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with publish pages as Spaces using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Spacefast workspace.
Find anything in Spacefast that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review publish pages as Spaces in Spacefast.
